MP-D001 通用与编辑

1440 CSS px桌面宿主；主页面/密集表单独立且可延长纵向画布以保留完整字段。窗口按源码宽度约束，板外画布可扩大而不缩成缩略图。

角色壳：所有者私有管理；只用平台真实主导航与8项设置二级菜单/实际插件宿主，不借ToDoo业务菜单。

独立场景：
A | ST-001 | 通用与编辑 | role=authenticated-owner | 实际baseline原状态/隔离示例的完整主布局；其他互斥状态另列设计板

完整构图：
完整设置页：8项真实设置二级菜单；默认编辑方式（开关允许时）、默认打开方式、换行、行号、字号、阅读宽度、外观、显示示意和保存/取消/默认/快捷键。document禁止split。

精确功能/字段/动作guard合同：
ST-001权限：管理API要求已登录所有者；除独立/auth处理路径外，/api写请求须同源Origin及x-csrf-token；维护模式503（apps/server/app.ts:141）。
ST-001字段顺序：默认编辑方式 [select; 可选]: document/source；仅documentEditingEnabled时显示 | 默认打开方式 [select; 可选]: edit/preview/split；文档编辑禁用split | 自动换行 [switch; 可选]: 既有控件 | 显示行号 [switch; 可选]: 既有控件 | 文字大小 [select; 可选]: 14/15/16/18/20px | 阅读宽度 [select; 可选]: comfortable/wide/full | 外观 [select; 可选]: system/light/dark
ST-001白名单：保存偏好 => 写入当前账户当前浏览器偏好；通知笔记显示更新；guard=本地偏好，无服务器写入
ST-001白名单：取消更改 => 载入已保存偏好；guard=dirty
ST-001白名单：恢复默认设置 => 只载入预览，保存后生效；guard=无额外确认
ST-001白名单：查看快捷键 => 打开ST-009；guard=已登录所有者；请求期间禁用重复操作

响应式合同：
1000px最大内容宽度；窄屏缩小内边距、操作区换行；≤600px返回按钮短标签；≤430px非开关偏好行纵排。源码支持，未运行浏览器验证。
390/320字段label/错误/长值换行，表格代码只在内部滚动，无页面级横溢出；限高窗口正文滚动/页脚可达/焦点可见；SettingsOverlay与PluginPanel关闭保护保持各自源码。逐source字段/滚动/焦点/guard在responsiveMappings。

硬性禁止：
ToDoo仅是style-only：提取真实两级层级、浅灰侧栏/白底、蓝色主动作、细线、小圆角、字体/间距/密度，禁止复制任务/日历/专注/习惯内容和菜单。DooKnow保留实际模块品牌。
不新增团队/成员/组织、AI聊天、社交登录、浏览器注册/找回密码或分享密码门。
协议元数据requestId、expectedVersion/expectedModifiedAt、hash、opaque cursor、nonce、CSRF默认不是可编辑输入；源码明确的只读回执/任务编号可显示合成占位；仅真实登记控件可编辑，state/data绑定中源码明确的只读显示也保留，API清单放设计审查注解而非产品。
所有秘密只用掩码或<token>/<private-key>；服务器位置仅用/srv/example占位；不显示真实凭据/原文/私有目录。
本地保存、Git提交、远端push、加密备份、博客发布/启用独立；不硬编码成功数量、在线状态或业务返回。
多面板是明确外部标注DESIGN BOARD的独立场景，最多3面板；绝不假装互斥窗口同时打开。

局部窗口/浮层/紧凑状态只画真实组件，不重画或发明外部导航。完整主页面保留自己的真实shell，公开/认证不得借主人chrome。sourceID/role/parent/caption可只存metadata，不强制烧录图中；无图内caption不单独构成失败。

使用匹配baseline的隔离内容：knowledge、Asia/Shanghai；公开示例“隔离示例手记”“示例作者”“让知识保持可用”“记录与回顾”；博客既有accent #44684f与三模板差异保持。未捕获状态仅合成示例，不固定成功数量/在线状态或业务结果。秘密只用掩码/placeholder。

同renderer的message/data/动作guard变体由stateCoverage精确绑定，只声称代表状态可见，不假称互斥状态共存。协议不伪造成输入；源码已有只读任务/回执编号保留占位显示。生成不等于实测或批准；逐图功能/权限/响应式及全局评审后才可开发。

多面板是明确外部标注DESIGN BOARD的独立场景，最多3面板；绝不假装互斥窗口同时打开。

局部窗口/浮层/紧凑状态只画真实组件，不重画或发明外部导航。完整主页面保留自己的真实shell，公开/认证不得借主人chrome。sourceID/role/parent/caption可只存metadata，不强制烧录图中；无图内caption不单独构成失败。

使用匹配baseline的隔离内容：knowledge、Asia/Shanghai；公开示例“隔离示例手记”“示例作者”“让知识保持可用”“记录与回顾”；博客既有accent #44684f与三模板差异保持。未捕获状态仅合成示例，不固定成功数量/在线状态或业务结果。秘密只用掩码/placeholder。

assets.prompt:
使用已核实内置GPT-Image2制作一个清晰中文UI设计资产。ToDoo仅style-only：浅灰/白底、蓝色主动作、细线小圆角、字体层级/间距/密度与响应式；保留DooKnow及真实模块菜单。

MP-D005 后台状态

1440 CSS px桌面宿主；主页面/密集表单独立且可延长纵向画布以保留完整字段。窗口按源码宽度约束，板外画布可扩大而不缩成缩略图。

角色壳：所有者私有管理；只用平台真实主导航与8项设置二级菜单/实际插件宿主，不借ToDoo业务菜单。

独立场景：
A | ST-005 | 后台状态 | role=authenticated-owner | 实际baseline原状态/隔离示例的完整主布局；其他互斥状态另列设计板

完整构图：
完整后台状态页：检索、索引、写入、同步、传输/备份任务，真实刷新与详情/跨页入口；保留分区各自失败。

精确功能/字段/动作guard合同：
ST-005/ST-041权限：管理API要求已登录所有者；除独立/auth处理路径外，/api写请求须同源Origin及x-csrf-token；维护模式503（apps/server/app.ts:141）。
ST-005/ST-041字段顺序：无额外编辑字段；源码已有只读state/data仍保留。
ST-005白名单：刷新状态 => 独立刷新索引、搜索、写入与任务；guard=已登录所有者；请求期间禁用重复操作；接口约束=GET /api/index/status; GET /api/platform/search-runtime; GET /api/maintenance/conflicts; GET /api/manage/tasks
ST-005白名单：打开搜索设置 / 打开异常写入恢复 / 导入与导出 / 备份与恢复 => 导航对应设置页面；guard=已登录所有者；请求期间禁用重复操作
ST-041白名单：检查并更新索引 => 请求扫描原文并更新；guard=无busy且索引状态可读取；接口约束=POST /api/index/refresh
ST-041白名单：打开搜索设置 / 核对写入与同步 / 打开异常写入恢复 => 导航设置；guard=已登录所有者；请求期间禁用重复操作
ST-041白名单：打开笔记 => 最近检查或冲突笔记入口；guard=已登录所有者；请求期间禁用重复操作

响应式合同：
1000px最大内容宽度；窄屏缩小内边距、操作区换行；≤600px返回按钮短标签；≤430px非开关偏好行纵排。源码支持，未运行浏览器验证。
390/320字段label/错误/长值换行，表格代码只在内部滚动，无页面级横溢出；限高窗口正文滚动/页脚可达/焦点可见；SettingsOverlay与PluginPanel关闭保护保持各自源码。逐source字段/滚动/焦点/guard在responsiveMappings。

硬性禁止：
ToDoo仅是style-only：提取真实两级层级、浅灰侧栏/白底、蓝色主动作、细线、小圆角、字体/间距/密度，禁止复制任务/日历/专注/习惯内容和菜单。DooKnow保留实际模块品牌。
不新增团队/成员/组织、AI聊天、社交登录、浏览器注册/找回密码或分享密码门。
协议元数据requestId、expectedVersion/expectedModifiedAt、hash、opaque cursor、nonce、CSRF默认不是可编辑输入；源码明确的只读回执/任务编号可显示合成占位；仅真实登记控件可编辑，state/data绑定中源码明确的只读显示也保留，API清单放设计审查注解而非产品。
所有秘密只用掩码或<token>/<private-key>；服务器位置仅用/srv/example占位；不显示真实凭据/原文/私有目录。
本地保存、Git提交、远端push、加密备份、博客发布/启用独立；不硬编码成功数量、在线状态或业务返回。
多面板是明确外部标注DESIGN BOARD的独立场景，最多3面板；绝不假装互斥窗口同时打开。

局部窗口/浮层/紧凑状态只画真实组件，不重画或发明外部导航。完整主页面保留自己的真实shell，公开/认证不得借主人chrome。sourceID/role/parent/caption可只存metadata，不强制烧录图中；无图内caption不单独构成失败。

使用匹配baseline的隔离内容：knowledge、Asia/Shanghai；公开示例“隔离示例手记”“示例作者”“让知识保持可用”“记录与回顾”；博客既有accent #44684f与三模板差异保持。未捕获状态仅合成示例，不固定成功数量/在线状态或业务结果。秘密只用掩码/placeholder。

同renderer的message/data/动作guard变体由stateCoverage精确绑定，只声称代表状态可见，不假称互斥状态共存。协议不伪造成输入；源码已有只读任务/回执编号保留占位显示。生成不等于实测或批准；逐图功能/权限/响应式及全局评审后才可开发。

forbiddenAdditions: ToDoo仅是style-only：提取真实两级层级、浅灰侧栏/白底、蓝色主动作、细线、小圆角、字体/间距/密度，禁止复制任务/日历/专注/习惯内容和菜单。DooKnow保留实际模块品牌。
不新增团队/成员/组织、AI聊天、社交登录、浏览器注册/找回密码或分享密码门。
协议元数据requestId、expectedVersion/expectedModifiedAt、hash、opaque cursor、nonce、CSRF默认不是可编辑输入；源码明确的只读回执/任务编号可显示合成占位；仅真实登记控件可编辑，state/data绑定中源码明确的只读显示也保留，API清单放设计审查注解而非产品。
所有秘密只用掩码或<token>/<private-key>；服务器位置仅用/srv/example占位；不显示真实凭据/原文/私有目录。
本地保存、Git提交、远端push、加密备份、博客发布/启用独立；不硬编码成功数量、在线状态或业务返回。
多面板是明确外部标注DESIGN BOARD的独立场景，最多3面板；绝不假装互斥窗口同时打开。
本机readiness不等于公网可达/客户端在线；全局ceiling与grant交集，收窄即时、扩大需显式重授权；稳定资源和目录后代范围必须准确。

角色壳：所有者私有管理；只用平台真实主导航与8项设置二级菜单/实际插件宿主，不借ToDoo业务菜单。

独立场景：
A | ST-067 | 编辑API客户端权限 | role=authenticated-owner | 实际baseline原状态/隔离示例的完整主布局；其他互斥状态另列设计板

完整构图：
API改权限完整行内表单：当前ceiling非空域/资源、保存/取消；active+通道可用+配置已保存。

精确功能/字段/动作guard合同：
ST-067权限：管理API要求已登录所有者；除独立/auth处理路径外，/api写请求须同源Origin及x-csrf-token；维护模式503（apps/server/app.ts:141）。
ST-067字段顺序：分域权限及资源 [domain-policy; 必填]: 使用当前服务ceiling；有效非空选择
ST-067白名单：保存客户端权限 => 按expectedGrantVersion更新，后续调用立即使用新权限；guard=active、MCP/API通道可用、配置已保存、非busy；接口约束=PUT /api/platform/mcp/api-clients/:id/permissions
ST-067白名单：取消 => 关闭form；guard=已登录所有者；请求期间禁用重复操作
共享MCPDomainPermissions真实字段（本宿主ceiling/请求业务过滤）：知识库 / 博客 / To Doo启用 [switch; 可选]: 仅实现的selectableDomains；初值按服务端policy | 知识库能力预设 [select; 可选]: 只读/内容编辑/自主整理；受ceiling约束 | 资源范围 [select; 可选]: all或selected；ceiling选定范围时禁止扩大为all | 指定资源 [resource-tree/multi-select; 可选]: 知识库稳定目录/笔记身份；To Doo清单；博客文章 | 独立权限与高级选项 [checkbox[]; 可选]: 各域implemented actions；read/write/organize/archive/index/share/manage等独立，受ceiling限制；不导入全局重绑动作到consent/ceiling。

插件卡片/操作区换行；PluginPanel内容独立滚动；插件自有样式使用Naive UI与注入CSS。源码支持，未运行。

ToDoo仅是style-only：提取真实两级层级、浅灰侧栏/白底、蓝色主动作、细线、小圆角、字体/间距/密度，禁止复制任务/日历/专注/习惯内容和菜单。DooKnow保留实际模块品牌。

协议元数据requestId、expectedVersion/expectedModifiedAt、hash、opaque cursor、nonce、CSRF默认不是可编辑输入；源码明确的只读回执/任务编号可显示合成占位；仅真实登记控件可编辑，state/data绑定中源码明确的只读显示也保留，API清单放设计审查注解而非产品。
所有秘密只用掩码或<token>/<private-key>；服务器位置仅用/srv/example占位；不显示真实凭据/原文/私有目录。
本地保存、Git提交、远端push、加密备份、博客发布/启用独立；不硬编码成功数量、在线状态或业务返回。
多面板是明确外部标注DESIGN BOARD的独立场景，最多3面板；绝不假装互斥窗口同时打开。
本机readiness不等于公网可达/客户端在线；全局ceiling与grant交集，收窄即时、扩大需显式重授权；稳定资源和目录后代范围必须准确。

局部窗口/浮层/紧凑状态只画真实组件，不重画或发明外部导航。完整主页面保留自己的真实shell，公开/认证不得借主人chrome。sourceID/role/parent/caption可只存metadata，不强制烧录图中；无图内caption不单独构成失败。

使用匹配baseline的隔离内容：knowledge、Asia/Shanghai；公开示例“隔离示例手记”“示例作者”“让知识保持可用”“记录与回顾”；博客既有accent #44684f与三模板差异保持。未捕获状态仅合成示例，不固定成功数量/在线状态或业务结果。秘密只用掩码/placeholder。

同renderer的message/data/动作guard变体由stateCoverage精确绑定，只声称代表状态可见，不假称互斥状态共存。协议不伪造成输入；源码已有只读任务/回执编号保留占位显示。生成不等于实测或批准；逐图功能/权限/响应式及全局评审后才可开发。

MP-D086 OAuth 连接授权：业务与资源策略

1440 CSS px桌面宿主；主页面/密集表单独立且可延长纵向画布以保留完整字段。窗口按源码宽度约束，板外画布可扩大而不缩成缩略图。

角色壳：已登录主人审阅的独立OAuth授权壳，无其私人笔记侧栏或数据；请求客户端身份不等于可信认证。

独立场景：
A | PB-018 | OAuth 连接授权：业务与资源策略 | role=authenticated owner | 实际baseline原状态/隔离示例的完整主布局；其他互斥状态另列设计板

完整构图：
独立OAuth授权完整页：实际请求客户端身份、域/操作/稳定资源范围和授权上限、可选offline_access及拒绝/允许访问；主人身份不等于可露私有侧栏。

精确功能/字段/动作guard合同：
PB-018权限：Owner session required; signed OAuth query <=16384 characters; exactly one client_id; resource must equal installation origin+/mcp; client must exist and be enabled. / Requested scopes intersect server policy and owner resource ceilings. ToDoo write requires read; v2 blog publish requires knowledge read.
PB-018字段顺序：permissionPolicy [domain permissions; 必填]: subset of server allowedPolicy; shared MCPDomainPermissions | offline_access [checkbox; 可选]: shown only when requested and allowed
PB-018白名单：拒绝 => Submit denial and redirect；guard=not busy; request loaded；接口约束=POST /api/platform/mcp/oauth/consent
PB-018白名单：允许访问 => Submit selected permissions and redirect；guard=valid selected policy; not busy；接口约束=POST /api/platform/mcp/oauth/consent
共享MCPDomainPermissions真实字段（本宿主ceiling/请求业务过滤）：知识库 / 博客 / To Doo启用 [switch; 可选]: 仅实现的selectableDomains；初值按服务端policy | 知识库能力预设 [select; 可选]: 只读/内容编辑/自主整理；受ceiling约束 | 资源范围 [select; 可选]: all或selected；ceiling选定范围时禁止扩大为all | 指定资源 [resource-tree/multi-select; 可选]: 知识库稳定目录/笔记身份；To Doo清单；博客文章 | 独立权限与高级选项 [checkbox[]; 可选]: 各域implemented actions；read/write/organize/archive/index/share/manage等独立，受ceiling限制；不导入全局重绑动作到consent/ceiling。

响应式合同：
Max 640px; <=600px reduces padding, wraps scope text and gives actions equal flexible widths (OAuthConsent.vue:339). Runtime unverified.
390/320字段label/错误/长值换行，表格代码只在内部滚动，无页面级横溢出；限高窗口正文滚动/页脚可达/焦点可见；SettingsOverlay与PluginPanel关闭保护保持各自源码。逐source字段/滚动/焦点/guard在responsiveMappings。

硬性禁止：
ToDoo仅是style-only：提取真实两级层级、浅灰侧栏/白底、蓝色主动作、细线、小圆角、字体/间距/密度，禁止复制任务/日历/专注/习惯内容和菜单。DooKnow保留实际模块品牌。
不新增团队/成员/组织、AI聊天、社交登录、浏览器注册/找回密码或分享密码门。
协议元数据requestId、expectedVersion/expectedModifiedAt、hash、opaque cursor、nonce、CSRF默认不是可编辑输入；源码明确的只读回执/任务编号可显示合成占位；仅真实登记控件可编辑，state/data绑定中源码明确的只读显示也保留，API清单放设计审查注解而非产品。
所有秘密只用掩码或<token>/<private-key>；服务器位置仅用/srv/example占位；不显示真实凭据/原文/私有目录。
本地保存、Git提交、远端push、加密备份、博客发布/启用独立；不硬编码成功数量、在线状态或业务返回。
多面板是明确外部标注DESIGN BOARD的独立场景，最多3面板；绝不假装互斥窗口同时打开。
认证/首启/OAuth/公开页面绝不出现主人私有导航栏、私有文件名/目录或管理入口。

局部窗口/浮层/紧凑状态只画真实组件，不重画或发明外部导航。完整主页面保留自己的真实shell，公开/认证不得借主人chrome。sourceID/role/parent/caption可只存metadata，不强制烧录图中；无图内caption不单独构成失败。

使用匹配baseline的隔离内容：knowledge、Asia/Shanghai；公开示例“隔离示例手记”“示例作者”“让知识保持可用”“记录与回顾”；博客既有accent #44684f与三模板差异保持。未捕获状态仅合成示例，不固定成功数量/在线状态或业务结果。秘密只用掩码/placeholder。

同renderer的message/data/动作guard变体由stateCoverage精确绑定，只声称代表状态可见，不假称互斥状态共存。协议不伪造成输入；源码已有只读任务/回执编号保留占位显示。生成不等于实测或批准；逐图功能/权限/响应式及全局评审后才可开发。

permissionRules: No owner session required; 43-character token must be active/unexpired and note exists.
No password field/gate exists. Public page has noindex,nofollow. Shared content follows latest saved original.
CanEdit requires edit permission and supported Markdown; large/long-line or graph-document sources remain read-only.

A resolved embedded whiteboard uses the current share board endpoint and board.capabilities.canDownloadSource; only that resolved capability governs source-tab availability. The server includes source content/path only when allowDiagramSource and the underlying resource permit it.

DiagramPreview canEdit requires !readOnly && !shareToken && resourceEdit; canGenerate additionally requires editable=true. A guest/shareToken can never edit design, edit diagram source, convert to whiteboard or generate portable preview, even when original-source download is allowed.
importantStates: images/attachments through capability; diagram previews read-only

Public graph-document and Excalidraw-reference read projections may be ordinary PNG preview images with public explanatory body and no source tab/download control; source-allowed setting does not turn such an image into an editor.

When an embedded whiteboard is actually resolved into DiagramPreview (including public rich editing), canDownloadSource=false hides the source tab and clears a previously visible source panel; preview/expand/retry remain the appropriate read controls.

For a resolved board whose capability explicitly permits source, source tab reveals only returned sourceText and its local Download source action. The same card still has no edit/convert/generate controls for a shareToken.
notes: Public guest page must retain guest-only navigation; no owner workspace rails.
Actual shared component path is apps/web/components/DiagramPreview.vue; there is no PublicDiagramPreview.vue at this baseline.

Ordinary inline SVG/Mermaid code already present in shared Markdown retains inline rendering; this is distinct from permission to fetch private/native board source. Do not infer original-source access from a source-tab screenshot or from note edit permission alone.

Download is a local Blob of sourceText: for Excalidraw this is boardSource || provided scene || fence code. The component does not fetch an owner asset or an extra source.path to fill missing source.content; do not depict such a fetch as implemented.

permissionRules: Capability grants edit only of this shared note; referenced whiteboards always view-only.
Source/write require edit token and supported document; maintenance blocks both. Write requires same Origin, JSON and separate anonymous CSRF; 30 requests/minute token rate.
Save uses expectedModifiedAt and stable requestId for same pending content/version; no owner private asset API.

PublicShareEditor initializes kind=document directly. NoteEditorHost calls parseSource with source-codec eligibility enabled=true; do not infer that public rich editing is disabled by the owner VITE_DOCUMENT_EDITOR_ENABLED setting.
The active public token and source/save restrictions remain authoritative in both modes, including after a rich-eligibility fallback; an empty body is not a validation failure.

A resolved embedded whiteboard uses the current share board endpoint and board.capabilities.canDownloadSource; only that resolved capability governs source-tab availability. The server includes source content/path only when allowDiagramSource and the underlying resource permit it.

DiagramPreview canEdit requires !readOnly && !shareToken && resourceEdit; canGenerate additionally requires editable=true. A guest/shareToken can never edit design, edit diagram source, convert to whiteboard or generate portable preview, even when original-source download is allowed.

fields.name: draft
fields.constraints: Markdown source; manual save; existing resource references retained; no new private images/whiteboards/uploads; blank draft is allowed. The save JSON payload must contain a string content property, including an empty string; payload-property presence is separate from UI/nonempty validation. Save eligibility is dirty-state and busy/loading/composing/blocked/expiry based, not nonempty based.

importantStates: no upload warning; existing attachments and diagram views retained
rich-editor fallback to source with warning
Blank body is valid; a dirty deletion to empty can be saved when the ordinary save guards permit it. An unchanged blank baseline is clean, not invalid.

Ctrl/Cmd+F or Ctrl/Cmd+H inside either mode opens the shared current-note find/replace panel; zero results disables next/previous and replacement actions. Escape closes it; case-sensitive matching, current replacement and replace-all remain local draft operations.
Find remains available while host readOnly is true; replacement input/actions are disabled while readOnly (busy/reloading), and replacement is guarded during composition.

Initial mode is document for a readable edit-capability source. parseSource rejects rich eligibility only when UTF-8 bytes exceed262144, source units exceed5000, nesting depth exceeds32, or cross-paragraph reference-link syntax requires preserving global references; fallback emits warning and switches to Markdown source.

Guest-reachable document context includes table controls, image description/delete/preview, existing-link edit/remove/open, preserved-source copy/delete confirmation and unsupported-paste choice; these reuse shared editor surfaces without owner publication/upload/navigation permissions.

Public graph-document and Excalidraw-reference read projections may be ordinary PNG preview images with public explanatory body and no source tab/download control; source-allowed setting does not turn such an image into an editor.

When an embedded whiteboard is actually resolved into DiagramPreview (including public rich editing), canDownloadSource=false hides the source tab and clears a previously visible source panel; preview/expand/retry remain the appropriate read controls.

For a resolved board whose capability explicitly permits source, source tab reveals only returned sourceText and its local Download source action. The same card still has no edit/convert/generate controls for a shareToken.
notes: Shared find/replace layout and detailed controls cross-reference coverage/workspace.json WS-045; public reachability is through NoteEditorHost keyboard handling, not an owner toolbar button.

PublicShareEditor exposes document/source mode, save and return-reading controls. It does not mount the owner full editor toolbar or handle NoteEditorHost insert-menu events, so do not add an owner insert menu to the public mockup.

Guest document context cross-references: WS-034 table toolbar, WS-035 image settings, WS-036 contextual link actions, WS-037 edit link, WS-038 image preview/zoom, WS-039 copy preserved original, WS-040 delete preserved content, WS-041 unsupported paste choice. These are shared-component layouts with public-specific guards, not duplicate owner-only pages.

Image preview resolves through the current share; replacement/upload actions emit the existing public upload-not-supported warning. Editing/deleting image descriptions or links changes the draft only; new private resource references remain rejected at save.

The public rich-eligibility fallback is distinct from a document chunk-load error: NoteEditorHost shows a preserved-content load-error warning and suggests switching modes; it does not mark the owner feature flag as public eligibility.
Actual shared component path is apps/web/components/DiagramPreview.vue; there is no PublicDiagramPreview.vue at this baseline.

Ordinary inline SVG/Mermaid code already present in shared Markdown retains inline rendering; this is distinct from permission to fetch private/native board source. Do not infer original-source access from a source-tab screenshot or from note edit permission alone.

Download is a local Blob of sourceText: for Excalidraw this is boardSource || provided scene || fence code. The component does not fetch an owner asset or an extra source.path to fill missing source.content; do not depict such a fetch as implemented.

permissionRules: No owner session required; 43-character token must be active/unexpired and note exists.

notes: Public guest page must retain guest-only navigation; no owner workspace rails.

permissionRules: Capability grants edit only of this shared note; referenced whiteboards always view-only.
Source/write require edit token and supported document; maintenance blocks both. Write requires same Origin, JSON and separate anonymous CSRF; 30 requests/minute token rate.
Save uses expectedModifiedAt and stable requestId for same pending content/version; no owner private asset API.

PublicShareEditor initializes kind=document directly. NoteEditorHost calls parseSource with source-codec eligibility enabled=true; do not infer that public rich editing is disabled by the owner VITE_DOCUMENT_EDITOR_ENABLED setting.
The active public token and source/save restrictions remain authoritative in both modes, including after a rich-eligibility fallback; an empty body is not a validation failure.

A resolved embedded whiteboard uses the current share board endpoint and board.capabilities.canDownloadSource; only that resolved capability governs source-tab availability. The server includes source content/path only when allowDiagramSource and the underlying resource permit it.

DiagramPreview canEdit requires !readOnly && !shareToken && resourceEdit; canGenerate additionally requires editable=true. A guest/shareToken can never edit design, edit diagram source, convert to whiteboard or generate portable preview, even when original-source download is allowed.

fields.name: draft
fields.constraints: Markdown source; manual save; existing resource references retained; no new private images/whiteboards/uploads; blank draft is allowed. The save JSON payload must contain a string content property, including an empty string; payload-property presence is separate from UI/nonempty validation. Save eligibility is dirty-state and busy/loading/composing/blocked/expiry based, not nonempty based.

importantStates: no upload warning; existing attachments and diagram views retained
rich-editor fallback to source with warning
Blank body is valid; a dirty deletion to empty can be saved when the ordinary save guards permit it. An unchanged blank baseline is clean, not invalid.

Ctrl/Cmd+F or Ctrl/Cmd+H inside either mode opens the shared current-note find/replace panel; zero results disables next/previous and replacement actions. Escape closes it; case-sensitive matching, current replacement and replace-all remain local draft operations.
Find remains available while host readOnly is true; replacement input/actions are disabled while readOnly (busy/reloading), and replacement is guarded during composition.

Initial mode is document for a readable edit-capability source. parseSource rejects rich eligibility only when UTF-8 bytes exceed262144, source units exceed5000, nesting depth exceeds32, or cross-paragraph reference-link syntax requires preserving global references; fallback emits warning and switches to Markdown source.

Guest-reachable document context includes table controls, image description/delete/preview, existing-link edit/remove/open, preserved-source copy/delete confirmation and unsupported-paste choice; these reuse shared editor surfaces without owner publication/upload/navigation permissions.

Public graph-document and Excalidraw-reference read projections may be ordinary PNG preview images with public explanatory body and no source tab/download control; source-allowed setting does not turn such an image into an editor.

When an embedded whiteboard is actually resolved into DiagramPreview (including public rich editing), canDownloadSource=false hides the source tab and clears a previously visible source panel; preview/expand/retry remain the appropriate read controls.

For a resolved board whose capability explicitly permits source, source tab reveals only returned sourceText and its local Download source action. The same card still has no edit/convert/generate controls for a shareToken.
notes: Shared find/replace layout and detailed controls cross-reference coverage/workspace.json WS-045; public reachability is through NoteEditorHost keyboard handling, not an owner toolbar button.

PublicShareEditor exposes document/source mode, save and return-reading controls. It does not mount the owner full editor toolbar or handle NoteEditorHost insert-menu events, so do not add an owner insert menu to the public mockup.

Guest document context cross-references: WS-034 table toolbar, WS-035 image settings, WS-036 contextual link actions, WS-037 edit link, WS-038 image preview/zoom, WS-039 copy preserved original, WS-040 delete preserved content, WS-041 unsupported paste choice. These are shared-component layouts with public-specific guards, not duplicate owner-only pages.

Image preview resolves through the current share; replacement/upload actions emit the existing public upload-not-supported warning. Editing/deleting image descriptions or links changes the draft only; new private resource references remain rejected at save.

The public rich-eligibility fallback is distinct from a document chunk-load error: NoteEditorHost shows a preserved-content load-error warning and suggests switching modes; it does not mark the owner feature flag as public eligibility.
Actual shared component path is apps/web/components/DiagramPreview.vue; there is no PublicDiagramPreview.vue at this baseline.

Ordinary inline SVG/Mermaid code already present in shared Markdown retains inline rendering; this is distinct from permission to fetch private/native board source. Do not infer original-source access from a source-tab screenshot or from note edit permission alone.

Download is a local Blob of sourceText: for Excalidraw this is boardSource || provided scene || fence code. The component does not fetch an owner asset or an extra source.path to fill missing source.content; do not depict such a fetch as implemented.

The active public token and source/save restrictions remain authoritative in both modes, including after a rich-eligibility fallback; an empty body is not a validation failure.

fields.name: draft
fields.constraints: same capability source/CAS/resource restrictions as document mode; blank draft is allowed. The save JSON payload must contain a string content property, including an empty string; payload-property presence is separate from UI/nonempty validation. Save eligibility is dirty-state and busy/loading/composing/blocked/expiry based, not nonempty based.

importantStates: plain source editing with same manual save status
Blank body is valid; a dirty deletion to empty can be saved when the ordinary save guards permit it. An unchanged blank baseline is clean, not invalid.

Ctrl/Cmd+F or Ctrl/Cmd+H inside either mode opens the shared current-note find/replace panel; zero results disables next/previous and replacement actions. Escape closes it; case-sensitive matching, current replacement and replace-all remain local draft operations.
Find remains available while host readOnly is true; replacement input/actions are disabled while readOnly (busy/reloading), and replacement is guarded during composition.

Source mode can be explicitly chosen for otherwise rich-eligible content or reached automatically by the size/unit/depth/reference-syntax fallback; warning explains why source mode preserves the original.
Attempting document mode again reruns parseSource eligibility; ineligible content falls back again without granting broader source/resource permissions.
notes: Shared find/replace layout and detailed controls cross-reference coverage/workspace.json WS-045; public reachability is through NoteEditorHost keyboard handling, not an owner toolbar button.

局部窗口/浮层/紧凑状态只画真实组件，不重画或发明外部导航。完整主页面保留自己的真实shell，公开/认证不得借主人chrome。sourceID/role/parent/caption可只存metadata，不强制烧录图中；无图内caption不单独构成失败。

使用匹配baseline的隔离内容：knowledge、Asia/Shanghai；公开示例“隔离示例手记”“示例作者”“让知识保持可用”“记录与回顾”；博客既有accent #44684f与三模板差异保持。未捕获状态仅合成示例，不固定成功数量/在线状态或业务结果。秘密只用掩码/placeholder。

同renderer的message/data/动作guard变体由stateCoverage精确绑定，只声称代表状态可见，不假称互斥状态共存。协议不伪造成输入；源码已有只读任务/回执编号保留占位显示。生成不等于实测或批准；逐图功能/权限/响应式及全局评审后才可开发。

响应式合同：
插件卡片/操作区换行；PluginPanel内容独立滚动；插件自有样式使用Naive UI与注入CSS。源码支持，未运行。
1000px最大内容宽度；窄屏缩小内边距、操作区换行；≤600px返回按钮短标签；≤430px非开关偏好行纵排。源码支持，未运行浏览器验证。
SettingsOverlay右侧抽屉或居中模态，视窗高度约束、内容滚动、页脚保留；busy阻止遮罩/Escape/关闭；焦点圈定及归还。源码支持，未运行。
390/320字段label/错误/长值换行，表格代码只在内部滚动，无页面级横溢出；限高窗口正文滚动/页脚可达/焦点可见；SettingsOverlay与PluginPanel关闭保护保持各自源码。逐source字段/滚动/焦点/guard在responsiveMappings。

硬性禁止：
ToDoo仅是style-only：提取真实两级层级、浅灰侧栏/白底、蓝色主动作、细线、小圆角、字体/间距/密度，禁止复制任务/日历/专注/习惯内容和菜单。DooKnow保留实际模块品牌。
不新增团队/成员/组织、AI聊天、社交登录、浏览器注册/找回密码或分享密码门。
协议元数据requestId、expectedVersion/expectedModifiedAt、hash、opaque cursor、nonce、CSRF默认不是可编辑输入；源码明确的只读回执/任务编号可显示合成占位；仅真实登记控件可编辑，state/data绑定中源码明确的只读显示也保留，API清单放设计审查注解而非产品。
所有秘密只用掩码或<token>/<private-key>；服务器位置仅用/srv/example占位；不显示真实凭据/原文/私有目录。
本地保存、Git提交、远端push、加密备份、博客发布/启用独立；不硬编码成功数量、在线状态或业务返回。
多面板是明确外部标注DESIGN BOARD的独立场景，最多3面板；绝不假装互斥窗口同时打开。
本机readiness不等于公网可达/客户端在线；全局ceiling与grant交集，收窄即时、扩大需显式重授权；稳定资源和目录后代范围必须准确。

局部窗口/浮层/紧凑状态只画真实组件，不重画或发明外部导航。完整主页面保留自己的真实shell，公开/认证不得借主人chrome。sourceID/role/parent/caption可只存metadata，不强制烧录图中；无图内caption不单独构成失败。

使用匹配baseline的隔离内容：knowledge、Asia/Shanghai；公开示例“隔离示例手记”“示例作者”“让知识保持可用”“记录与回顾”；博客既有accent #44684f与三模板差异保持。未捕获状态仅合成示例，不固定成功数量/在线状态或业务结果。秘密只用掩码/placeholder。

同renderer的message/data/动作guard变体由stateCoverage精确绑定，只声称代表状态可见，不假称互斥状态共存。协议不伪造成输入；源码已有只读任务/回执编号保留占位显示。生成不等于实测或批准；逐图功能/权限/响应式及全局评审后才可开发。

响应式合同：
插件卡片/操作区换行；PluginPanel内容独立滚动；插件自有样式使用Naive UI与注入CSS。源码支持，未运行。
SettingsOverlay右侧抽屉或居中模态，视窗高度约束、内容滚动、页脚保留；busy阻止遮罩/Escape/关闭；焦点圈定及归还。源码支持，未运行。
1000px最大内容宽度；窄屏缩小内边距、操作区换行；≤600px返回按钮短标签；≤430px非开关偏好行纵排。源码支持，未运行浏览器验证。
390/320字段label/错误/长值换行，表格代码只在内部滚动，无页面级横溢出；限高窗口正文滚动/页脚可达/焦点可见；SettingsOverlay与PluginPanel关闭保护保持各自源码。逐source字段/滚动/焦点/guard在responsiveMappings。

硬性禁止：
ToDoo仅是style-only：提取真实两级层级、浅灰侧栏/白底、蓝色主动作、细线、小圆角、字体/间距/密度，禁止复制任务/日历/专注/习惯内容和菜单。DooKnow保留实际模块品牌。
不新增团队/成员/组织、AI聊天、社交登录、浏览器注册/找回密码或分享密码门。
协议元数据requestId、expectedVersion/expectedModifiedAt、hash、opaque cursor、nonce、CSRF默认不是可编辑输入；源码明确的只读回执/任务编号可显示合成占位；仅真实登记控件可编辑，state/data绑定中源码明确的只读显示也保留，API清单放设计审查注解而非产品。
所有秘密只用掩码或<token>/<private-key>；服务器位置仅用/srv/example占位；不显示真实凭据/原文/私有目录。
本地保存、Git提交、远端push、加密备份、博客发布/启用独立；不硬编码成功数量、在线状态或业务返回。
多面板是明确外部标注DESIGN BOARD的独立场景，最多3面板；绝不假装互斥窗口同时打开。
Git本地commit成功即使push失败仍存在；unknown沿原request核对，干净已保存才pull，分歧停止。PluginPanel不凭空添加busy/dirty关闭保护。

局部窗口/浮层/紧凑状态只画真实组件，不重画或发明外部导航。完整主页面保留自己的真实shell，公开/认证不得借主人chrome。sourceID/role/parent/caption可只存metadata，不强制烧录图中；无图内caption不单独构成失败。

使用匹配baseline的隔离内容：knowledge、Asia/Shanghai；公开示例“隔离示例手记”“示例作者”“让知识保持可用”“记录与回顾”；博客既有accent #44684f与三模板差异保持。未捕获状态仅合成示例，不固定成功数量/在线状态或业务结果。秘密只用掩码/placeholder。

同renderer的message/data/动作guard变体由stateCoverage精确绑定，只声称代表状态可见，不假称互斥状态共存。协议不伪造成输入；源码已有只读任务/回执编号保留占位显示。生成不等于实测或批准；逐图功能/权限/响应式及全局评审后才可开发。

硬性禁止：
ToDoo仅是style-only：提取真实两级层级、浅灰侧栏/白底、蓝色主动作、细线、小圆角、字体/间距/密度，禁止复制任务/日历/专注/习惯内容和菜单。DooKnow保留实际模块品牌。
不新增团队/成员/组织、AI聊天、社交登录、浏览器注册/找回密码或分享密码门。
协议元数据requestId、expectedVersion/expectedModifiedAt、hash、opaque cursor、nonce、CSRF默认不是可编辑输入；源码明确的只读回执/任务编号可显示合成占位；仅真实登记控件可编辑，state/data绑定中源码明确的只读显示也保留，API清单放设计审查注解而非产品。
所有秘密只用掩码或<token>/<private-key>；服务器位置仅用/srv/example占位；不显示真实凭据/原文/私有目录。
本地保存、Git提交、远端push、加密备份、博客发布/启用独立；不硬编码成功数量、在线状态或业务返回。
多面板是明确外部标注DESIGN BOARD的独立场景，最多3面板；绝不假装互斥窗口同时打开。
Git本地commit成功即使push失败仍存在；unknown沿原request核对，干净已保存才pull，分歧停止。PluginPanel不凭空添加busy/dirty关闭保护。

局部窗口/浮层/紧凑状态只画真实组件，不重画或发明外部导航。完整主页面保留自己的真实shell，公开/认证不得借主人chrome。sourceID/role/parent/caption可只存metadata，不强制烧录图中；无图内caption不单独构成失败。

使用匹配baseline的隔离内容：knowledge、Asia/Shanghai；公开示例“隔离示例手记”“示例作者”“让知识保持可用”“记录与回顾”；博客既有accent #44684f与三模板差异保持。未捕获状态仅合成示例，不固定成功数量/在线状态或业务结果。秘密只用掩码/placeholder。

同renderer的message/data/动作guard变体由stateCoverage精确绑定，只声称代表状态可见，不假称互斥状态共存。协议不伪造成输入；源码已有只读任务/回执编号保留占位显示。生成不等于实测或批准；逐图功能/权限/响应式及全局评审后才可开发。

permissionRules: Capability grants edit only of this shared note; referenced whiteboards always view-only.
Source/write require edit token and supported document; maintenance blocks both. Write requires same Origin, JSON and separate anonymous CSRF; 30 requests/minute token rate.
Save uses expectedModifiedAt and stable requestId for same pending content/version; no owner private asset API.

PublicShareEditor initializes kind=document directly. NoteEditorHost calls parseSource with source-codec eligibility enabled=true; do not infer that public rich editing is disabled by the owner VITE_DOCUMENT_EDITOR_ENABLED setting.
The active public token and source/save restrictions remain authoritative in both modes, including after a rich-eligibility fallback; an empty body is not a validation failure.

A resolved embedded whiteboard uses the current share board endpoint and board.capabilities.canDownloadSource; only that resolved capability governs source-tab availability. The server includes source content/path only when allowDiagramSource and the underlying resource permit it.

DiagramPreview canEdit requires !readOnly && !shareToken && resourceEdit; canGenerate additionally requires editable=true. A guest/shareToken can never edit design, edit diagram source, convert to whiteboard or generate portable preview, even when original-source download is allowed.

fields.name: draft
fields.constraints: Markdown source; manual save; existing resource references retained; no new private images/whiteboards/uploads; blank draft is allowed. The save JSON payload must contain a string content property, including an empty string; payload-property presence is separate from UI/nonempty validation. Save eligibility is dirty-state and busy/loading/composing/blocked/expiry based, not nonempty based.

importantStates: no upload warning; existing attachments and diagram views retained
rich-editor fallback to source with warning
Blank body is valid; a dirty deletion to empty can be saved when the ordinary save guards permit it. An unchanged blank baseline is clean, not invalid.

Ctrl/Cmd+F or Ctrl/Cmd+H inside either mode opens the shared current-note find/replace panel; zero results disables next/previous and replacement actions. Escape closes it; case-sensitive matching, current replacement and replace-all remain local draft operations.
Find remains available while host readOnly is true; replacement input/actions are disabled while readOnly (busy/reloading), and replacement is guarded during composition.

Initial mode is document for a readable edit-capability source. parseSource rejects rich eligibility only when UTF-8 bytes exceed262144, source units exceed5000, nesting depth exceeds32, or cross-paragraph reference-link syntax requires preserving global references; fallback emits warning and switches to Markdown source.

Guest-reachable document context includes table controls, image description/delete/preview, existing-link edit/remove/open, preserved-source copy/delete confirmation and unsupported-paste choice; these reuse shared editor surfaces without owner publication/upload/navigation permissions.

Public graph-document and Excalidraw-reference read projections may be ordinary PNG preview images with public explanatory body and no source tab/download control; source-allowed setting does not turn such an image into an editor.

When an embedded whiteboard is actually resolved into DiagramPreview (including public rich editing), canDownloadSource=false hides the source tab and clears a previously visible source panel; preview/expand/retry remain the appropriate read controls.

For a resolved board whose capability explicitly permits source, source tab reveals only returned sourceText and its local Download source action. The same card still has no edit/convert/generate controls for a shareToken.
notes: Shared find/replace layout and detailed controls cross-reference coverage/workspace.json WS-045; public reachability is through NoteEditorHost keyboard handling, not an owner toolbar button.

PublicShareEditor exposes document/source mode, save and return-reading controls. It does not mount the owner full editor toolbar or handle NoteEditorHost insert-menu events, so do not add an owner insert menu to the public mockup.

Guest document context cross-references: WS-034 table toolbar, WS-035 image settings, WS-036 contextual link actions, WS-037 edit link, WS-038 image preview/zoom, WS-039 copy preserved original, WS-040 delete preserved content, WS-041 unsupported paste choice. These are shared-component layouts with public-specific guards, not duplicate owner-only pages.

Image preview resolves through the current share; replacement/upload actions emit the existing public upload-not-supported warning. Editing/deleting image descriptions or links changes the draft only; new private resource references remain rejected at save.

The public rich-eligibility fallback is distinct from a document chunk-load error: NoteEditorHost shows a preserved-content load-error warning and suggests switching modes; it does not mark the owner feature flag as public eligibility.
Actual shared component path is apps/web/components/DiagramPreview.vue; there is no PublicDiagramPreview.vue at this baseline.

Ordinary inline SVG/Mermaid code already present in shared Markdown retains inline rendering; this is distinct from permission to fetch private/native board source. Do not infer original-source access from a source-tab screenshot or from note edit permission alone.

Download is a local Blob of sourceText: for Excalidraw this is boardSource || provided scene || fence code. The component does not fetch an owner asset or an extra source.path to fill missing source.content; do not depict such a fetch as implemented.

permissionRules: Capability grants edit only of this shared note; referenced whiteboards always view-only.
Source/write require edit token and supported document; maintenance blocks both. Write requires same Origin, JSON and separate anonymous CSRF; 30 requests/minute token rate.
Save uses expectedModifiedAt and stable requestId for same pending content/version; no owner private asset API.

PublicShareEditor initializes kind=document directly. NoteEditorHost calls parseSource with source-codec eligibility enabled=true; do not infer that public rich editing is disabled by the owner VITE_DOCUMENT_EDITOR_ENABLED setting.
The active public token and source/save restrictions remain authoritative in both modes, including after a rich-eligibility fallback; an empty body is not a validation failure.

A resolved embedded whiteboard uses the current share board endpoint and board.capabilities.canDownloadSource; only that resolved capability governs source-tab availability. The server includes source content/path only when allowDiagramSource and the underlying resource permit it.

DiagramPreview canEdit requires !readOnly && !shareToken && resourceEdit; canGenerate additionally requires editable=true. A guest/shareToken can never edit design, edit diagram source, convert to whiteboard or generate portable preview, even when original-source download is allowed.

fields.name: draft
fields.constraints: Markdown source; manual save; existing resource references retained; no new private images/whiteboards/uploads; blank draft is allowed. The save JSON payload must contain a string content property, including an empty string; payload-property presence is separate from UI/nonempty validation. Save eligibility is dirty-state and busy/loading/composing/blocked/expiry based, not nonempty based.

importantStates: no upload warning; existing attachments and diagram views retained
rich-editor fallback to source with warning
Blank body is valid; a dirty deletion to empty can be saved when the ordinary save guards permit it. An unchanged blank baseline is clean, not invalid.

Ctrl/Cmd+F or Ctrl/Cmd+H inside either mode opens the shared current-note find/replace panel; zero results disables next/previous and replacement actions. Escape closes it; case-sensitive matching, current replacement and replace-all remain local draft operations.
Find remains available while host readOnly is true; replacement input/actions are disabled while readOnly (busy/reloading), and replacement is guarded during composition.

Initial mode is document for a readable edit-capability source. parseSource rejects rich eligibility only when UTF-8 bytes exceed262144, source units exceed5000, nesting depth exceeds32, or cross-paragraph reference-link syntax requires preserving global references; fallback emits warning and switches to Markdown source.

Guest-reachable document context includes table controls, image description/delete/preview, existing-link edit/remove/open, preserved-source copy/delete confirmation and unsupported-paste choice; these reuse shared editor surfaces without owner publication/upload/navigation permissions.

Public graph-document and Excalidraw-reference read projections may be ordinary PNG preview images with public explanatory body and no source tab/download control; source-allowed setting does not turn such an image into an editor.

When an embedded whiteboard is actually resolved into DiagramPreview (including public rich editing), canDownloadSource=false hides the source tab and clears a previously visible source panel; preview/expand/retry remain the appropriate read controls.

For a resolved board whose capability explicitly permits source, source tab reveals only returned sourceText and its local Download source action. The same card still has no edit/convert/generate controls for a shareToken.
notes: Shared find/replace layout and detailed controls cross-reference coverage/workspace.json WS-045; public reachability is through NoteEditorHost keyboard handling, not an owner toolbar button.

PublicShareEditor exposes document/source mode, save and return-reading controls. It does not mount the owner full editor toolbar or handle NoteEditorHost insert-menu events, so do not add an owner insert menu to the public mockup.

Guest document context cross-references: WS-034 table toolbar, WS-035 image settings, WS-036 contextual link actions, WS-037 edit link, WS-038 image preview/zoom, WS-039 copy preserved original, WS-040 delete preserved content, WS-041 unsupported paste choice. These are shared-component layouts with public-specific guards, not duplicate owner-only pages.

Image preview resolves through the current share; replacement/upload actions emit the existing public upload-not-supported warning. Editing/deleting image descriptions or links changes the draft only; new private resource references remain rejected at save.

The public rich-eligibility fallback is distinct from a document chunk-load error: NoteEditorHost shows a preserved-content load-error warning and suggests switching modes; it does not mark the owner feature flag as public eligibility.
Actual shared component path is apps/web/components/DiagramPreview.vue; there is no PublicDiagramPreview.vue at this baseline.

Ordinary inline SVG/Mermaid code already present in shared Markdown retains inline rendering; this is distinct from permission to fetch private/native board source. Do not infer original-source access from a source-tab screenshot or from note edit permission alone.

Download is a local Blob of sourceText: for Excalidraw this is boardSource || provided scene || fence code. The component does not fetch an owner asset or an extra source.path to fill missing source.content; do not depict such a fetch as implemented.

permissionRules: Capability grants edit only of this shared note; referenced whiteboards always view-only.

Save uses expectedModifiedAt and stable requestId for same pending content/version; no owner private asset API.

PublicShareEditor initializes kind=document directly. NoteEditorHost calls parseSource with source-codec eligibility enabled=true; do not infer that public rich editing is disabled by the owner VITE_DOCUMENT_EDITOR_ENABLED setting.
The active public token and source/save restrictions remain authoritative in both modes, including after a rich-eligibility fallback; an empty body is not a validation failure.

A resolved embedded whiteboard uses the current share board endpoint and board.capabilities.canDownloadSource; only that resolved capability governs source-tab availability. The server includes source content/path only when allowDiagramSource and the underlying resource permit it.

DiagramPreview canEdit requires !readOnly && !shareToken && resourceEdit; canGenerate additionally requires editable=true. A guest/shareToken can never edit design, edit diagram source, convert to whiteboard or generate portable preview, even when original-source download is allowed.

fields.name: draft
fields.constraints: Markdown source; manual save; existing resource references retained; no new private images/whiteboards/uploads; blank draft is allowed. Save eligibility is dirty-state and busy/loading/composing/blocked/expiry based, not nonempty based.

importantStates: no upload warning; existing attachments and diagram views retained
rich-editor fallback to source with warning
Blank body is valid; a dirty deletion to empty can be saved when the ordinary save guards permit it. An unchanged blank baseline is clean, not invalid.

Ctrl/Cmd+F or Ctrl/Cmd+H inside either mode opens the shared current-note find/replace panel; zero results disables next/previous and replacement actions. Escape closes it; case-sensitive matching, current replacement and replace-all remain local draft operations.
Find remains available while host readOnly is true; replacement input/actions are disabled while readOnly (busy/reloading), and replacement is guarded during composition.

Initial mode is document for a readable edit-capability source. parseSource rejects rich eligibility only when UTF-8 bytes exceed262144, source units exceed5000, nesting depth exceeds32, or cross-paragraph reference-link syntax requires preserving global references; fallback emits warning and switches to Markdown source.

Guest-reachable document context includes table controls, image description/delete/preview, existing-link edit/remove/open, preserved-source copy/delete confirmation and unsupported-paste choice; these reuse shared editor surfaces without owner publication/upload/navigation permissions.

Public graph-document and Excalidraw-reference read projections may be ordinary PNG preview images with public explanatory body and no source tab/download control; source-allowed setting does not turn such an image into an editor.

When an embedded whiteboard is actually resolved into DiagramPreview (including public rich editing), canDownloadSource=false hides the source tab and clears a previously visible source panel; preview/expand/retry remain the appropriate read controls.

For a resolved board whose capability explicitly permits source, source tab reveals only returned sourceText and its local Download source action. The same card still has no edit/convert/generate controls for a shareToken.
notes: Shared find/replace layout and detailed controls cross-reference coverage/workspace.json WS-045; public reachability is through NoteEditorHost keyboard handling, not an owner toolbar button.

PublicShareEditor exposes document/source mode, save and return-reading controls. It does not mount the owner full editor toolbar or handle NoteEditorHost insert-menu events, so do not add an owner insert menu to the public mockup.

Guest document context cross-references: WS-034 table toolbar, WS-035 image settings, WS-036 contextual link actions, WS-037 edit link, WS-038 image preview/zoom, WS-039 copy preserved original, WS-040 delete preserved content, WS-041 unsupported paste choice. These are shared-component layouts with public-specific guards, not duplicate owner-only pages.

Image preview resolves through the current share; replacement/upload actions emit the existing public upload-not-supported warning. Editing/deleting image descriptions or links changes the draft only; new private resource references remain rejected at save.

The public rich-eligibility fallback is distinct from a document chunk-load error: NoteEditorHost shows a preserved-content load-error warning and suggests switching modes; it does not mark the owner feature flag as public eligibility.
Actual shared component path is apps/web/components/DiagramPreview.vue; there is no PublicDiagramPreview.vue at this baseline.

Ordinary inline SVG/Mermaid code already present in shared Markdown retains inline rendering; this is distinct from permission to fetch private/native board source. Do not infer original-source access from a source-tab screenshot or from note edit permission alone.

Download is a local Blob of sourceText: for Excalidraw this is boardSource || provided scene || fence code. The component does not fetch an owner asset or an extra source.path to fill missing source.content; do not depict such a fetch as implemented.

精确功能/字段/动作guard合同：
ST-029权限：管理API要求已登录所有者；除独立/auth处理路径外，/api写请求须同源Origin及x-csrf-token；维护模式503（apps/server/app.ts:141）。
ST-029字段顺序：无额外编辑字段；源码已有只读state/data仍保留。

响应式合同：
1000px最大内容宽度；窄屏缩小内边距、操作区换行；≤600px返回按钮短标签；≤430px非开关偏好行纵排。源码支持，未运行浏览器验证。
390/320字段label/错误/长值换行，表格代码只在内部滚动，无页面级横溢出；限高窗口正文滚动/页脚可达/焦点可见；SettingsOverlay与PluginPanel关闭保护保持各自源码。逐source字段/滚动/焦点/guard在responsiveMappings。

硬性禁止：
ToDoo仅是style-only：提取真实两级层级、浅灰侧栏/白底、蓝色主动作、细线、小圆角、字体/间距/密度，禁止复制任务/日历/专注/习惯内容和菜单。DooKnow保留实际模块品牌。
不新增团队/成员/组织、AI聊天、社交登录、浏览器注册/找回密码或分享密码门。
协议元数据requestId、expectedVersion/expectedModifiedAt、hash、opaque cursor、nonce、CSRF默认不是可编辑输入；源码明确的只读回执/任务编号可显示合成占位；仅真实登记控件可编辑，state/data绑定中源码明确的只读显示也保留，API清单放设计审查注解而非产品。
所有秘密只用掩码或<token>/<private-key>；服务器位置仅用/srv/example占位；不显示真实凭据/原文/私有目录。
本地保存、Git提交、远端push、加密备份、博客发布/启用独立；不硬编码成功数量、在线状态或业务返回。
多面板是明确外部标注DESIGN BOARD的独立场景，最多3面板；绝不假装互斥窗口同时打开。

局部窗口/浮层/紧凑状态只画真实组件，不重画或发明外部导航。完整主页面保留自己的真实shell，公开/认证不得借主人chrome。sourceID/role/parent/caption可只存metadata，不强制烧录图中；无图内caption不单独构成失败。

使用匹配baseline的隔离内容：knowledge、Asia/Shanghai；公开示例“隔离示例手记”“示例作者”“让知识保持可用”“记录与回顾”；博客既有accent #44684f与三模板差异保持。未捕获状态仅合成示例，不固定成功数量/在线状态或业务结果。秘密只用掩码/placeholder。

同renderer的message/data/动作guard变体由stateCoverage精确绑定，只声称代表状态可见，不假称互斥状态共存。协议不伪造成输入；源码已有只读任务/回执编号保留占位显示。生成不等于实测或批准；逐图功能/权限/响应式及全局评审后才可开发。

硬性禁止：
ToDoo仅是style-only：提取真实两级层级、浅灰侧栏/白底、蓝色主动作、细线、小圆角、字体/间距/密度，禁止复制任务/日历/专注/习惯内容和菜单。DooKnow保留实际模块品牌。
不新增团队/成员/组织、AI聊天、社交登录、浏览器注册/找回密码或分享密码门。
协议元数据requestId、expectedVersion/expectedModifiedAt、hash、opaque cursor、nonce、CSRF默认不是可编辑输入；源码明确的只读回执/任务编号可显示合成占位；仅真实登记控件可编辑，state/data绑定中源码明确的只读显示也保留，API清单放设计审查注解而非产品。
所有秘密只用掩码或<token>/<private-key>；服务器位置仅用/srv/example占位；不显示真实凭据/原文/私有目录。
本地保存、Git提交、远端push、加密备份、博客发布/启用独立；不硬编码成功数量、在线状态或业务返回。
多面板是明确外部标注DESIGN BOARD的独立场景，最多3面板；绝不假装互斥窗口同时打开。

局部窗口/浮层/紧凑状态只画真实组件，不重画或发明外部导航。完整主页面保留自己的真实shell，公开/认证不得借主人chrome。sourceID/role/parent/caption可只存metadata，不强制烧录图中；无图内caption不单独构成失败。
